question_text: Muscular contractions of the alimentary canal are ______.
explanation: Peristalsis is the coordinated, rhythmic contraction and relaxation of muscles in the alimentary canal. It transports food through the digestive tract.

question_text: The original function of the vertebrate stomach was ________.
explanation: The source explanation says the primitive vertebrate stomach primarily served as a storage chamber, allowing food to be held before moving into the intestines for further digestion.

question_text: In human body, the food passes through a continuous canal which begins at ______ and ends at anus.
